_comment: Governed-gate manifest consumed by bin/check-pr-preflight and bin/refresh-governance-artifacts (docs/specs/governed-gates.md §1). Every fast repo-state gate hosted CI blocks merge on appears here; tests/Architecture/PreflightParityTest.php binds this file to composer.json and the workflow files so it cannot drift from CI. {base} in a run command is replaced with the diff base ref (committed-state gates).

gates.repair: fix the reported composer.json policy violation (CPxxx codes are documented in bin/check-composer-policy)
rename the offending tracked path to a portable form
move the dependency to a permitted layer or add a KERNEL_EXEMPT_FILES entry with rationale
use the Waaseyaa abstraction or extend .symfony-import-allowlist.json with a reviewed entry

refresh.instruction: use the Waaseyaa abstraction, or add a reviewed .symfony-import-allowlist.json entry

gates.repair: add the missing path to phpstan.neon paths
add the missing test directory to phpunit.xml.dist
remove the skip from a required-hosted proof, narrow a broad catch, or add a reviewed tools/phpunit-skip-policy.json entry with an explicit predicate and rationale

refresh.instruction: classify the exact semantic site in tools/phpunit-skip-policy.json; required-hosted files and broad catches cannot be allowlisted

gates.repair: restore the PL008 detection behavior in bin/check-package-layers
keep distribution-extension packages out of the core metapackage require graphs

review the reported tool change — it alters the local operator's least-privilege default (ADR-022 D-7) — then regenerate with php bin/check-local-operator-tool-profile --write-roster and commit support/local-operator-tool-profile-roster.json

refresh.instruction: the roster records the local operator's least-privilege default (ADR-022 D-7) — review what changed, decide deliberately whether the tool belongs on LocalOperatorToolProfile::DEFAULT_TOOL_IDS, then run php bin/check-local-operator-tool-profile --write-roster and commit the roster

gates.repair: bind the query (->setAccount / ->accessCheck(false)) or append a commented exemption via php bin/check-getquery-bindings --generate-baseline

refresh.instruction: php bin/check-getquery-bindings --generate-baseline, then replace every "# TODO: add exemption reason" stub with a real reviewed reason before committing

gates.repair: fix the dispatcher key or regenerate with php bin/check-dispatcher-keys --generate-baseline
use the canonical admin coercion helper for the flagged pattern
restore detection behavior in bin/check-admin-coercion-patterns
rebuild the admin dist with bin/build-admin-dist and commit the result
rebuild and re-accept the admin dist with bin/build-admin-dist and commit dist/, dist.signature and dist.manifest.json together
restore the field-guard wiring the test asserts (including the ci.yml run_gate line)
fix the access-hardening finding or add a reviewed tools/access-hardening-baseline.php entry

refresh.instruction: fix the finding or add a reviewed tools/access-hardening-baseline.php entry with rationale

gates.repair: regenerate/fix the OpenAPI document per bin/check-openapi output
amend support/s1-v1.json (sole support-policy authority) or the real surface it binds; the checker derives every expected value from the contract

refresh.instruction: hand-edit support/s1-v1.json (the sole support-policy authority) and the real surface it binds; bin/check-support-contract carries no policy values to synchronize

gates.repair: review the diff, then php bin/check-s1-sqlite-contract --write-construction-roster and commit the roster
review the diff, then php bin/check-s1-configuration-activation --write-roster and commit the roster
review the diff, then php bin/check-s1-configuration-authority --write-roster and commit the roster
restore schema and causal conformance, or append a new event without changing prior ledger bytes
restore immutable-source validation, exact-set transaction, rollback, and row-level verification
review the diff, then php bin/check-s1-schema-authority --write-roster and commit the roster
route the access through the governed secret surface or add a reviewed tools/governed-secret-access-baseline.php entry

refresh.instruction: route the access through the governed secret surface or add a reviewed tools/governed-secret-access-baseline.php entry

gates.repair: route debug/environment classification through RuntimePolicy or add a reviewed low-layer baseline entry with rationale

refresh.instruction: route the policy through RuntimePolicy; baseline only an unavoidable lower-layer authority with explicit package-cycle rationale

gates.repair: add a changed coverage-bearing Unit/Contract companion that exercises the affected branch through a real public boundary
fix the CHANGELOG.md structure per bin/check-changelog-shape output
fix fragment names/content per changes/README.md and rerun the validator
add the missing contract-suite coverage entry
restore the required ingestion defaults invariants under defaults/
remove the secret-shaped finding (and rotate the credential if it was real)
restore the exactly-once publish shape in the release workflows
keep every current map entry loadable; for a removal or public downgrade, add the exact current-change CHANGELOG directive documented in stability-charter.md §8.1

refresh.instruction: record each new public element's disposition in docs/public-surface-map.php; authorize a removal, rename, or public downgrade only with the exact current-change CHANGELOG grammar in stability-charter.md §8.1

gates.repair: update the affected spec in the same change set, or commit a 'spec-reviewed: <spec-path> - <reason>' trailer
add a validated changes/unreleased fragment (the PR-body 'no-changelog: <reason>' override is applied by CI only)
composer cs-fix
fix the reported static-analysis errors (single-process fallback: php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/phpstan analyse)
delete the dead code or mark an intentional extension point with @api (baseline regen per CLAUDE.md is a reviewed exception)

refresh.instruction: delete the dead code or mark intentional extension points with @api; baseline regeneration (phpstan-dead-code-baseline.neon) is a reviewed exception per CLAUDE.md
